items.title: Chickpea quality from hyperspectral imaging
items.alt: Chickpea seed varieties under imaging, with a diagram of seed composition and box plots of predicted protein content by variety
items.text: Predicting protein and composition of chickpea varieties and flour from hyperspectral data, so breeders and processors can screen quality without wet chemistry.

items.title: Finding weak contamination signals in meat
items.alt: Grid of steak hyperspectral images and abundance maps from classical and deep unmixing methods for E. coli, fat and meat
items.text: A benchmark for detecting faint E. coli signatures in steak with hyperspectral unmixing, comparing classical methods with transformer and CNN models. Follow-up work includes the WS-Net weak-signal unmixing model.

items.title: Cattle behaviour from video
items.alt: Cattle in a paddock with detection boxes and pose keypoints overlaid
items.text: Detecting and tracking individual cattle in the field and classifying their behaviour over time, for welfare, early disease detection and breeding. We released the CVB dataset and a CVAT-based tool that cuts annotation time by labelling only behaviour changes.

items.title: Sugarcane disease and resilience
items.alt: Hyperspectral sugarcane leaf images after graph-Laplacian processing, with a table of ResNet results
items.text: Near-infrared hyperspectral imaging with CNNs to identify mosaic-resistant sugarcane varieties and to catch smut disease before symptoms show.

items.title: Counting beneficial insects released by drone
items.alt: A drone fitted with an insect dispersal unit on a lab bench
items.text: YOLOv5 and DETR models count insects and larvae in mixtures dispersed by UAVs, so growers can check that natural pest control is spread where it is needed.

items.title: Restoring historical documents
items.alt: Torn document fragments, detected fragment pieces and a reconstructed historical map
items.text: Detecting tears, creases and faded text in archival documents, then reassembling and digitising them.

items.title: Remote monitoring for Parkinson's disease
items.alt: System diagram linking a patient's wearable sensors to a clinician through a central server
items.text: Wireless inertial sensors and cameras separate normal movement from tremor, scored against the UPDRS scale so clinicians can follow patients at home.

items.title: Robot mapping and navigation
items.alt: A mobile robot with a laptop, a diagram of map exchange between robots, and reconstructed 3D maps of a room
items.text: Mobile robots that build 2D and 3D maps of their surroundings and plan paths around obstacles, with maps shared between robots.
